tool_schemas.name: get-stock-data
tool_schemas.description: Returns stored market data for the requested ticker (optionally disambiguated by exchange) and, when include_snapshot is true, includes the latest computed snapshot for that symbol. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when ticker is missing/blank or exchange/include_snapshot are invalid types, and NOT_FOUND when the ticker (and exchange, if provided) does not resolve to a known symbol or no data has been ingested for it. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to read stock data and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol to fetch data for (e.g., AAPL).

exchange.description: Optional exchange code to disambiguate the ticker.

include_snapshot.description: Whether to include the latest computed stock snapshot for the symbol.

tool_schemas.name: get-stock-alerts
tool_schemas.description: Lists alert records matching the provided filters (symbol_id or ticker, optional status), returning up to limit results and a next-page cursor when more results are available; pass cursor to continue pagination, and sort controls ordering. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid symbol_id format, unsupported status/sort values, out-of-range limit, or when cursor is not a valid pagination token, and NOT_FOUND when a specified symbol_id/ticker does not correspond to a known symbol. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read alerts and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

symbol_id.description: Filter alerts by AlphaVantage symbol id (symbols.id).

ticker.description: Filter alerts by ticker symbol (alternative to symbol_id).

limit.description: Maximum number of alerts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get-daily-stock-data
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored daily OHLCV bars for a symbol (by symbol_id or ticker) filtered inclusively by start_date/end_date, returning up to limit bars and a next-page cursor when more results are available; pass cursor to continue pagination, and sort controls ordering by trading_date. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid symbol_id format, out-of-range limit, invalid cursor, invalid datetime formats, or when start_date is after end_date, and NOT_FOUND when the specified symbol_id/ticker does not correspond to a known symbol. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read time-series data and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

symbol_id.description: AlphaVantage symbol id to fetch daily OHLCV bars for (symbols.id).

ticker.description: Ticker symbol to fetch daily OHLCV bars for (alternative to symbol_id).

start_date.description: Inclusive start datetime to filter daily bars by trading_date.

end_date.description: Inclusive end datetime to filter daily bars by trading_date.

limit.description: Maximum number of daily bars to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of bars.

sort.description: Sort order for returned daily bars.

tool_schemas.name: get-symbols
tool_schemas.description: Lists known symbols in the service, optionally filtered by ticker/exchange/status, returning up to limit results and a next-page cursor when more results are available; pass cursor to continue pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for unsupported status/sort values, out-of-range limit, or an invalid cursor token.

ticker.description: Filter symbols by exact ticker (e.g., AAPL).

exchange.description: Filter symbols by exchange code (e.g., NASDAQ).

limit.description: Maximum number of symbols to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: create-alert-rule
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new alert rule for a symbol; the rule is validated for supported rule_type and threshold fields, and is created in status=active unless status=paused is explicitly requested. Returns the created alert rule record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields, when symbol_id does not exist, or when the referenced symbol is not active.

symbol_id.description: AlphaVantage symbol id (symbols.id) the rule applies to.

rule_type.description: Type of condition evaluated for the symbol.

threshold_number.description: Numeric threshold used by rule types that compare decimal values (e.g., price or percent change).

threshold_integer.description: Integer threshold used by rule types that compare integer values (e.g., volume).

is_recurring.description: Whether the rule can trigger repeatedly over time (subject to cooldown_minutes).

cooldown_minutes.description: Minimum minutes between triggers when is_recurring is true.

status.description: Initial lifecycle status for the rule (deleted is not allowed on create).

tool_schemas.name: update-alert-rule
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing alert rule by id, including lifecycle transitions between active and paused, or deleting the rule (status=deleted). Returns the updated alert rule. Refuses invalid lifecycle transitions (e.g., changing a deleted rule), and raises VALIDATION_ERROR for unsupported field combinations or threshold values.

threshold_number.description: Updated numeric threshold (if applicable to rule_type).

threshold_integer.description: Updated integer threshold (if applicable to rule_type).

is_recurring.description: Whether the rule can trigger repeatedly over time (subject to cooldown_minutes).

status.description: Update lifecycle status; allowed transitions: active<->paused, and active/paused->deleted.

tool_schemas.name: acknowledge-stock-alert
tool_schemas.description: Acknowledges an active alert by id, transitioning alerts.status from active to acknowledged and returning the updated alert. Refuses the request when the alert is not currently active (e.g., already acknowledged or expired).

tool_schemas.name: create-ingestion-job
tool_schemas.description: Enqueues a new ingestion job to fetch and upsert daily OHLCV data (Alpha Vantage) for a symbol, creating a queued ingestion_jobs record and returning it. Refuses invalid job_type values, unknown symbols, or attempts to start ingestion for a delisted symbol.

job_type.description: Type of ingestion job to create.

symbol_id.description: AlphaVantage symbol id (symbols.id) to ingest for.

alpha_vantage_endpoint.description: Alpha Vantage endpoint variant used for the job (recorded for observability).

metadata.name: Alpha Vantage Stock Server
metadata.description: This backend powers a lightweight stock-data service backed by Alpha Vantage, storing ingested time-series market data, computed snapshots, and user-defined alert rules. The primary workflows are: periodically fetching daily OHLCV data, serving latest/overview stock data reads, and evaluating alert
